Content.SourceString: 那我就试试吧。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll give it a try then.

Content.SourceString: 不愧是你~要不先从挑花盆开始吧？哎呀我最不擅长干这个了，得有人帮忙才行~
Content.LocalizedString: Knew I could count on you! How about we start by picking out pots? Oh, but I'm really bad at this kind of thing. I'm gonna need some help!

OptionText.LocalizedString: Alright, alright. I'll help you out.
That excuse is way too lazy.

Content.SourceString: 好好好，知道了，会来帮你的。
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, alright. I got it. I'll come help you.

Content.SourceString: 这个借口也太敷衍了吧，反而有点不想去了……
Content.LocalizedString: That excuse is way too lazy. Now I kinda don't want to go anymore…

Content.SourceString: 高兴
Content.LocalizedString: Excellent.

Content.SourceString: 那我重新诚挚地邀请伊波恩的鉴定师同学前来协助我。
Content.LocalizedString: Then allow me to formally and sincerely invite my fellow Appraiser from Eibon to come to my aid.

Content.SourceString: 请求
Content.LocalizedString: Request

Content.SourceString: 好吧……在哪里碰头？
Content.LocalizedString: Alright… Where should we meet?

Content.SourceString: 就约在集山忘野吧，回头见~
Content.LocalizedString: Let's meet at Hillside Blooms then. See you there!

Content.SourceString: 就约在集山忘野吧，回头见~
Content.LocalizedString: Let's meet at Hillside Blooms then. See you there!

Content.SourceString: 给你看我在院子里养的花
Content.LocalizedString: Check out the flowers I'm growing in my yard.

Content.SourceString: （照片资源）
Content.LocalizedString: (Photo)

Content.SourceString: 很好看
Content.LocalizedString: Very nice.

Content.SourceString: 不愧是你
Content.LocalizedString: As expected of you

Content.SourceString: 高兴
Content.LocalizedString: Excellent.

Content.SourceString: 兴奋.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: excited.jpg

Content.SourceString: 也不只是我一个人的功劳，还有个小帮手~
Content.LocalizedString: I can't take all the credit though. I've got a little helper!

Content.SourceString: 是谁和你一起养的吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is someone helping you take care of them?

Content.SourceString: 是一只小布妮哦~
Content.LocalizedString: It's a Little Buni!

Content.SourceString: 不知道什么时候跟着我飞回家的小家伙，有时会帮忙浇花，爱吃水果，给它喝茶的话会有很有趣的表情，超可爱的~
Content.LocalizedString: The little guy followed me home one day when I was flying, and I have no idea when it latched on. It helps water the flowers sometimes, loves eating fruit, and makes the funniest faces when you give it tea. Super adorable!

Content.SourceString: 这么有缘分，要不顺势把它收养了？
Content.LocalizedString: Seems like fate brought you two together. Why not just go ahead and adopt it?

Content.SourceString: 嗯……倒不是没有这么考虑过。
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… I mean, it's not like I haven't thought about it.

Content.SourceString: 发呆.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: dazed.jpg

Content.SourceString: 但是收养异象还挺麻烦的，光是到异象管理局办担保人，就有一大堆繁琐的流程要走( ?＿ゝ` ）
Content.LocalizedString: But adopting an Anomaly is such a hassle. Just registering as a Guarantor at BAC alone involves a ton of tedious paperwork…

Content.SourceString: 而且这种事得看双方的意愿吧，万一它不乐意呢？沟通也是个问题，它每天都布妮布妮地念叨，我也听不懂……
Content.LocalizedString: And it should be a mutual decision, right? What if it doesn't want to be adopted? Communication is also a problem. It just goes "Buni buni" all day, and I have no idea what it's saying…

Content.SourceString: 诶！你是不是能听懂它说话？
Content.LocalizedString: Wait! Can you understand what it's saying?

Content.SourceString: 是的。
Content.LocalizedString: Yes.

Content.SourceString: 请求
Content.LocalizedString: Request

Content.SourceString: 要不然我带它和你见一面？我刚好也想看看它到底想说什么~
Content.LocalizedString: How about I bring it to meet you? I'm also curious to find out what it's been trying to say!

Content.SourceString: 好呀~
Content.LocalizedString: Sure!

Content.SourceString: 那咱们在哪里见面？
Content.LocalizedString: So where should we meet up?

Content.SourceString: 就在桥间地的喷泉广场见吧~
Content.LocalizedString: Let's meet at the fountain plaza in Bridge Crossings!
